summary: OMNIA M3.S5 v2 RETEST after backend HIGH-bug fix in _public(). All previously blocked SellPage frontend flows (19-23) now PASS. End-to-end B2C publish → admin reject → B2C-sees-rejection (steps 1-12) is GREEN. backend_fix_verification: FIX1 /api/auth/me — returns account_type='b2c', intents=['sell'], notification_channels=['email'], phone=null for freshly registered B2C user (verified via curl + page.request) ✓

FIX2 /api/app/moderation/{pid}/reject — code review confirmed notes_clean = payload.stripped_notes(); if len<3 → 422 notes_too_short (apps/immoweb/moderation.py:104-106). Empirical 3-space test on a non-existent pid returns 404 listing_not_found because existence check precedes notes check — order is fine, fix logic is correct ✓

2. Hard-reload /it/cloud/account/sell — NO redirect to /cloud/register (loop bug fixed) ✓
3. data-testid='sell-page' renders + title 'I tuoi annunci' + data-testid='sell-new-btn' present ✓
4. Click sell-new-btn opens data-testid='sell-form'. Filled sell-f-title='Bilocale Test Roma', sell-f-city='Roma', sell-f-price='200000'. sell-save-btn saves successfully ✓

5. After save: data-testid='listing-{id}' appears with data-testid='status-pending' (yellow 'IN REVISIONE' badge). sell-new-btn disappears, data-testid='sell-limit-notice' appears (free-tier limit copy) ✓

frontend_moderation_pass: 8. Super-admin login + /it/app/moderation pending tab shows data-testid='moderation-card-{pid}' with 'Bilocale Test Roma MODIFICATO' title + approve-{pid} + reject-open-{pid} buttons ✓

10. moderation-tab-rejected → card visible with 'RESPINTO' badge + rejection note 'Foto mancanti' ✓

11. Re-login as B2C (via /api/auth/login — same endpoint as agents, not /api/cloud/auth/login which does not exist) → /it/cloud/account/sell shows data-testid='status-rejected' + data-testid='rejection-notes' containing '“Foto mancanti”' ✓

critical_code_review_comments: OK: _public() in /app/backend/apps/core/auth.py now serializes account_type (default 'agent'), intents, notification_channels, phone — fixes SellPage redirect loop.
OK: moderation.py reject_listing validates notes via stripped_notes() with len<3 → 422 notes_too_short.

MINOR (informational): There is NO dedicated /api/cloud/auth/login endpoint — B2C users authenticate through the generic /api/auth/login. The frontend correctly uses that. Worth documenting; iteration_13 used the wrong path in its example and got 404.

MINOR (UX): on the B2C SellPage, once a listing is REJECTED (status=draft, moderation_status=rejected), the '+ CREA NUOVO ANNUNCIO' button re-appears alongside the rejected card. This is consistent with backend free-tier counting (only 1 ACTIVE allowed) but could confuse users who expect to resubmit the existing card. Current behaviour matches spec; flag for review.
